brief: Identify a factual error and assemble supporting evidence for a dispute.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Document an error"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Documenta un error"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Documente um erro"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify a factual error and assemble supporting evidence for a dispute.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A precise discrepancy is easier to investigate than a general complaint.
instruction.misconception: Disliking an accurate entry is the same as identifying a factual reporting error.
instruction.numeracy_support: Every quantity and assumption needed to decide is visible in the current scenario. Examples explain the relationship before independent application.

evidence.reasoning: Report says unpaid; a matching receipt confirms payment before that reporting date. Preserve both and identify the conflicting entry.
The documents identify the payment and conflicting account entry.
The explanation identifies the specific disputed information.
A dispute needs an inaccurate fact, not an unwanted outcome.
Copies and references help track what was submitted.
Different dates can explain a legitimate balance change.
The packet connects the disputed status to its supporting record.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
